answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the shale graph is rebuilt each epoch, the relic merge is applied at settlement and the bridge audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 5 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 29 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
